certificate.label: Internet Certificate Issuance (icert free print)
notes: Issuance center host is https://icert.yonsei.ac.kr/ (WebMinwon ReportX free print).
Start from portal 인터넷증명서 → 인터넷즉시발급; VERIFY URL is original-check only.
Official print hands an encrypted dzreportx ticket to a Windows-only listener on 127.0.0.1:65432.
The macOS compatibility agent decodes the current encrypted ticket, materializes the pinned ReportX runtime profile, and independently renders the returned FP3 prepared report to PDF.
Document-number reservation is an explicit one-shot mutation guarded against automatic retry; PDF rendering never calls printcomplete.
A compatibility PDF is unverified and is not automatically an official electronic certificate or paper original.
Out of scope for this skill: paid 전자증명서발급 electronic PDF product.
